items.q: Which areas in Eunpyeong-gu are nearby?
items.a: We are located right next to Dongmyeong Girls' High School. It's a 5-minute walk from Yeonsinnae Station, making it highly accessible from Yeonsinnae, Bulgwang, Gusan, Yeokchon, and Eungam.

items.q: Is the practice room available 24 hours?
items.a: Yes. Resident members can access their rooms freely 24/7 via individual door lock codes.

items.q: How about parking and public transportation?
items.a: You can use the affordable public parking lot in Daejo-dong, a 1-2 minute walk away. Public transit access is easy via Bulgwang Station or Yeonsinnae Station (Lines 3 and 6), and the bus stop "Dongmyeong Girls' High School / Catholic Bulgwang-dong Church" is right in front.

items.q: Can I freely use heating and cooling in summer and winter?
items.a: Each room is equipped with the latest independent, draft-free HVAC system, providing comfort year-round.

items.q: Is it safe to leave instruments or gear?
items.a: Ten CCTV cameras record corridors and common areas 24/7, and each room has its own digital door lock for security.
We use broadcast-grade STC soundproofing to minimize noise between rooms. It provides excellent immersion for vocals, voiceovers, and MIDI work.
